title: An email to a colleague
instructionsRu: В письме есть ошибки. Выпиши каждый неправильный фрагмент и исправление в виде «неправильно → правильно».
material: Hi Anna! I am writing you because I need a help with the report. Yesterday I have finished the first part, but the second part is more difficult. My boss want it on Friday. Could you look at the numbers, please? I think I made the mistake in the second table. We can meet in Monday morning if it suits you. Thanks a lot!
